column1: # M3-ASSY-R8 placement table (build step 4, frozen): every part that is not rigid R7 copy (check_r8 STRIP_PARTS, CH1_PARTS, J1, J122).
# KiCad mm, y = 0 at the aft edge, +y forward; rot = KiCad orientation in degrees; side F (top) / B (bottom). basis: seed (partial/b0_place_final.tsv),
# spike-a/b/c/d (m3_design/r8_spikes/*/RESULT.md), legalised (a legaliser nudge of a seed / spike position), Dnn (R8_DECISIONS). r8_pcb.py places it and r8_legalise.py
# must find it legal (the build stops otherwise); m3_design/r8_keepclear.tsv holds the routing it was frozen against.
# --- MCU core under U1 (D1; spike a): U1 at rotation 0, flash U3 and crystal Y1 on the bottom under it, decoupling at its pins, the QSPI / HSE / NRST / BOOT0 dives
# --- Pyro sense series resistors at the ADC pins (F8): R168 (CONT, pin 15) forward of U1, R170 (ARM, pin 33) and R172 (RAW_ACT_SENSE, pin 34) under U1's east pad row (spike a; D33)
# --- RAW_ACT_SENSE divider at J122's aft end, tapped from J122.11 (D32)
# --- 3V3A filter and the VLOGIC / V3V3 sense dividers at pins 17 / 18 (D33)
# --- RF interface resistors at the MCU end and the strip's non-rigid parts (spike d P1/P2; D4, D17)
# --- Status LEDs on the west edge (D3) and the SWD pad J2 beside them (spike d P7)
# --- IMU and barometer on the bottom, rotation 0 (D13: the default position, D38)
# --- Buzzer and pull-pin (seed; Q123 / R162 clear of the pyro corridor, spike a)
# --- Servo interface (spike b; D7): F.Cu lanes straight from U1.22-25, pull-downs on the rows, 1k series on B.Cu, D121 on B.Cu at rotation 180
# --- Battery band (spike c "west chain"; D30 R5 L10 nudges): actuator switch, gate drive, switch legs, input protection at J1.1, RAW_ACT bulk
# --- eFuse U9 aft of J121's L10 zone on the BAT_IN feed lane, its network, the RAW_PROTECTED output parts (D36)
# --- Logic power: hold-up C84 (top), mux U11 and 3V3 buck U2 / L1 on the bottom (seed, legalised; D39). Step 5: the 3V3 buck as
#     DS41326 Figure 25 (D40: SW faces L1, VIN / GND at the aft end with C6 across them, C7 beside, Cout C8 / C9 aft of L1 on its
#     3V3 end, C5 at BST); the mux U11 turned so IN2 faces the USB_LIMITED feed from the south, IN1 north-west, OUT north-east (D42)
# --- Camera supply: eFuse U7 and buck U8 / L3 (D37). Step 5 (D41): the buck stage as DS42002 Figure 39: SW forward into L3, C72
#     across VIN / GND at U8's east end, C73 beside it, C74 at BST, Cout C75 / C76 at L3's 5V end, the feedback network on the top
